key_scope: One fresh fixture per parameter shared across sign/verify passes; keygen produces fresh keys per operation.
cold_definition: Fresh process per batch, fixture loading and verification-input generation outside measured region; repeated operations within a batch amortize process-local first use. No CPU cache flush.
baseline_definition: Official C reference paths with -O3 and no project ISA/vector optimization. Preserve upstream portable/SWAR algorithms. MQOM C reference equals optimized sources by upstream design; portable C selection explicitly recorded.
PMU_scope: User-mode, process-specific, start-disabled perf events controlled by child FD enable/disable and ACK. Original API loop/clock/syscall boundary overhead disclosed, no manual correction.
profile_privacy: Frame-pointer address callchains only, no DWARF user-stack bytes, no user registers, raw sample payloads, physical addresses or kernel profiling. No secret fixtures or entropy in archive.
ratios: Hotspot self=sample period weight at IP / all sample period weight including unknown; children inclusive overlaps and not additive; not precise wall-time percentages.
quality: Correctness and identity failures stop that case. Sampling limitations/lost/unknown/multiplexing are explicit; no selective retry for faster results.
constraints: Do not modify earlier experiments or manuscript.
Do not change governor, IRQ, system permissions or other users processes.
No automatic commit or upload; local full archive and Chinese reports required.
